intro: Kzan Thornslash is an orc weapon merchant stationed in the Valley of Trials in Durotar. He provides essential starter weaponry and supplies to fresh recruits beginning their training under the Horde.

p: Situated within the dusty red canyon of the Valley of Trials, Kzan Thornslash serves as the primary weapon vendor for young orcs and Darkspear trolls taking their first steps as warriors of the Horde. Offering an assortment of basic armaments—ranging from crude hand axes and shortswords to clubs and throwing knives—Kzan ensures that newly awakened aspirants are armed adequately to face the local wildlife and regional hazards.
